description: This PHP class defines the model EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel used within the OrangeHRM project. It represents an employee's allowed languages and fluency IDs, including methods for serializing data and retrieving related employee language information via a service.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel
classes.description: A model representing allowed languages and fluency options for an employee, with serialization and data-fetching capabilities.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeLanguageService used to fetch employee language data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the object to an array, including logic to fetch current employee languages and determine allowed fluency IDs for each language.
